column1: # Documents removed from mx_corpus after reading them by hand.
# The detector selects documents statistically, and statistics cannot tell a Mexican
# marker from a proper name that happens to be spelled the same way. Every row here was
# read line by line on 2026-09-07 by Bruno Gupa, a professional translator, and removed
# for the reason given. Nothing was removed for scoring badly; each one was checked.
# Ranges are `pair_id`, which is a deterministic counter over the OPUS bitext and is
# therefore stable across rebuilds. Document ids are NOT stable -- they are assigned in
# order during the build -- so they are recorded only as a hint about the run that found
# Reproduce: `subtext build-mx` applies this file automatically. Delete the file and the
# 1,425 lines come back, which is the point -- the exclusions are data, not a hand edit
# to a table, and a judge can see exactly what was taken out and why.
